_readme: Human-curated corrections to TD's PROHIBITION rows for the public-light-bus cut-off layer, each citing a TD prohibited-zone notice (tnid in prohibited-zones.json).

The rows lag the Commissioner's notices by 1-35 months, in both directions. An entry lives here only while TD's data disagrees with TD's notice; `node scripts/audit-cutoff-notices.mjs` says when one has become redundant.
close: designate every CENTERLINE route of `st` (or only `routeIds`) as a PLB prohibited zone, BOUND 0 both ways / 1 digitised / -1 reverse.
open: drop the PROHIBITION row `prohibitionId` (must sit on `st`, as a guard against id reuse).
Never add an entry from a sign or from prose alone: a notice must state it, and for a `close` a TS119/TS522 should stand on the road.

close.why: Designated a PLB prohibited zone from its junction with Castle Peak Road - Lam Tei northbound on 15 Aug 2022; two TS119 stand on it; no PROHIBITION row in the 2026-09 network.

open.why: Zone rescinded 16 Nov 2025; row 11116 (created 2011) still present and sealed a 178 m cut-off area.
